decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Time limit
The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - In accordance with approved drawings and Documents
The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with:

Document received 29/04/2026
M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021001-P02 (Site Location Plan); M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021002-P02 (Existing Block Plan); M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021003-P02 (Proposed Block Plan); M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021004-P01 (Existing Plan Marjory Warren and Staff Car Parks); M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021005-P01 (Proposed Plan Marjory Warren and Staff Car Parks); M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021006-P01 (Existing South Car Park) prepared by Hunters; M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021007-P01 (Proposed South Car Park); M10604-HUN-ZZ-02-D-A-021008-P01 (Proposed Cycle Shelter)

Document received 20/08/2026
425.068006.00001/PD02/AT01 Rev C (Swept Path Analysis Large Car (SDV) & 4.6t Light Van (HATS))

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission, a satisfactory standard of development is secured, and to allow the Local Planning Authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.
Condition : 3 - Vehicle Tracking and Junction Geometry 
Prior to the commencement of development associated with the Hepple Close car park alterations, detailed drawings of the proposed carriageway widening, kerb alignments and curve geometry shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall demonstrate that the layout is capable of safely accommodating the movement and manoeuvring of authorised vehicles, including HATS vehicles. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such.
Reason: In the interests of highway safety and to ensure the satisfactory operation of the car park.
Condition : 4 - Parking Management Plan
Prior to the first use of the development hereby approved, a Parking Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include details of the management and operation of the relocated parking spaces: 
(a) management of disabled parking spaces;
(b) management of HATS parking spaces;
(c) management of DTEC drop-off spaces;
(d) operation of EV charging infrastructure;
(e) ANPR arrangements;
(f) parking enforcement measures;
(g) strategy for monitoring Blue Badge demand.
The approved Parking Management Plan shall be implemented prior to the first use of the development and adhered to thereafter. 
Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved. 
Condition : 5 - Construction Logistics Plan (CLP)
The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Logistics Plan secured pursuant to planning permission P/2022/2424. No changes to the approved construction access arrangements, routing strategy, traffic management measures or construction vehicle management arrangements shall take place unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure that construction activities are appropriately managed and do not give rise to adverse impacts on highway safety, pedestrian safety, traffic operation or residential amenity.
Condition : 6 - Wayfinding 
Prior to the first use of the development hereby approved, a Wayfinding and Signage Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Strategy shall include details of directional signage and wayfinding measures identifying routes between the relocated Blue Badge parking spaces, HATS parking spaces, cycle parking facilities, DTEC Building, hospital entrances and public transport connections.
The approved strategy shall be implemented in full prior to the first use of the development and retained thereafter.
Reason: To ensure users can safely and easily navigate the hospital estate, promote active travel and maximise the accessibility benefits of the approved pedestrian and cycle infrastructure.
Condition : 7 - Cycle Parking
Prior to the first use of the cycle parking hereby approved, detailed drawings of the cycle parking layout shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:
(a) a minimum spacing of 0.4 metres between two-tier cycle parking stands;
(b) an appropriate mix of two-tier cycle stands, and single-tier Sheffield stands (minimum 20%);
(c) details of cycle parking security measures;
(d) details of CCTV and access control arrangements.
The cycle parking shall thereafter be provided and retained in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: To ensure the provision of high quality, safe and accessible cycle parking facilities.
Condition : 8 - The development hereby approved shall only be implemented in connection with the retention of the Renal Building planning application reference P/2026/1288 (or any successor consent). The approved parking, cycle parking and associated infrastructure shall remain available for the purposes of serving the Diagnostic Teaching and Education Centre and wider hospital estate.
Reason: To ensure the coordinated delivery of the linked planning applications.
description: Installation of external bollards, enlargement of the existing cycle storage and Relocation of approved car parking for the development of planning permission P/2022/2424.
